svg.title: Darb, a local business directory for Israel
svg.desc: Describe what you need in your own words. Darb reads what you want, where, and what it must have. 13,000+ real businesses across 1,138 places and 211 kinds of business, about 1,500 tests on every pull request.

text.tspan: A local business directory for Israel. Describe what
you need the way you'd say it to a friend. Darb reads
the intent, matches it against what each business
actually offers, and shows it on a map you can move

g.text: renovator who works Saturdays in Tamra
a hair salon close to me
gluten-free dinner in Akko, open now
Answers instantly in the browser, then refines with a language model.
real businesses, each with a source
